title: Actual Roos completeness under constant scalar restriction
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of the l-adic field in Type u, X a Noetherian scheme in universe u, and K an arbitrary object of the derived category of modules over the actual continuous integral coefficient ring [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. Transport K by restriction along the inverse canonical point coefficient isomorphism [def-sfb-integral-constant-model-realization], and then restrict scalars from the continuous integer ring to the constant integer ring [det-lem-integral-models-stacks]. K is complete for its canonical augmented quotient Roos complex if and only if the resulting section-module complex on the equivalent coefficient-sized small pro-etale site is ConstantCompletion.IsComplete for the kernel of the first residue map. No boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

proof.text: Use the explicit conservative derived constant section transport F and its comparison with the target smallDerivedObject.

Choose a singleton generator of the residue kernel and apply the existing general ringedKoszulCompletionReflector. Its IsIso(unit) iff local completeness clause applies to the prescribed kernel ideal.

Choose a native K-flat resolution of a localization representative of K. Compare its actual augmented quotient Roos complex with the prescribed Koszul unit. Cancel the comparison isomorphism and reflect invertibility through F.

Apply representative independence for actual completeness and isomorphism invariance of local completeness along Q(P) isomorphic to K and the target object comparison. This proves both directions without boundedness.

theorem internal_completion_stacks_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X)) :
    IsDerivedComplete l E X K ↔
      ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
        (IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsStacks.residueMap l E X))
        (IntegralModelsStacks.smallDerivedObject X _
          ((IntegralModelsStacks.restriction l E X).obj
          ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap
            (IntegralConstantModel.pointComparison l E).inv.hom X)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            K)))
